title: Exclusion from civil rights commission.
bodyText: Notwithstanding the provisions of chapter 368, this part shall not be subject to chapter 368 and shall not be enforced by the civil rights commission.
bodyHtml: [§489-23]  Exclusion from civil rights commission.  Notwithstanding the provisions of chapter 368, this part shall not be subject to chapter 368 and shall not be enforced by the civil rights commission. [L 2000, c 227, pt of §2]
